title: Watch: Blood donors get a Halloween fright in Thailand
summary: Thai Red Cross workers dressed up as part of a Halloween-themed blood drive in the country's capital Bangkok.

blocks.text: Thai Red Cross workers dressed up as part of a Halloween-themed blood drive in the country's capital Bangkok.
The charity gave free themed t-shirts to donors as part of the event, and said it expected turnout to more than double compared to a typical Saturday.
